loadError: The ballot could not be loaded. Please try again.

blocked.ALREADY_VOTED: You have already voted. A ballot can be cast only once, and your receipt was shown right after you voted.
blocked.VOTING_NOT_OPEN: Voting has not opened yet. Please come back when it starts.
blocked.NOT_ELIGIBLE: You are not eligible to vote in this election.
blocked.NO_ELECTION: No election has been set up yet.

intro.title: Your ballot
intro.posts_one: There is {{count}} post to vote on.
intro.posts_other: There are {{count}} posts to vote on.
intro.how: You will see one post at a time. You may skip any post and leave it blank. You can review and change everything before you submit.
intro.once: You can vote only once. After you submit, your choices cannot be changed.
intro.secret: Nothing links your name to your choices. Your selections stay in this page only and are never saved on your device.
intro.photo: At the end you will take a photo with your camera. It lets the Election Commission settle a dispute if one is raised. It is not linked to your choices, only the Election Commission can see it, and it is deleted after the dispute period.

step.chooseOne: Choose 1 candidate, or skip this post.
step.chooseUpTo: Choose up to {{count}} candidates, or skip this post.
step.limitReached: You have chosen the maximum for this post. Unselect a candidate to pick another.
step.noCandidates: No candidates are standing for this post.

review.title: Review your choices
review.intro: Check every post. You can change any choice before you continue.

photo.title: Take your photo
photo.explain: Look at the camera and take a clear photo of your face. You must take a photo to submit your vote.
photo.required: Take a photo to enable the submit button.
photo.denied: Camera access was blocked. Allow the camera for this site in your browser settings, then press the button again.
photo.notFound: No camera was found on this device.
photo.unsupported: This browser cannot use the camera. Please try another browser such as Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge.
photo.error: The camera could not be started. Please try again.

confirm.title: Cast your vote?
confirm.body: You can vote only once. After you confirm, your choices cannot be changed.

errors.ALREADY_VOTED: You have already voted. A ballot can be cast only once.
errors.VOTING_CLOSED: Voting has closed, so your vote was not recorded.
errors.NOT_ELIGIBLE: You are not eligible to vote in this election.
errors.TOO_MANY_SELECTIONS: You chose more candidates than a post allows. Please review your choices.
errors.INVALID_CHOICES: One of your choices is not valid any more. Please go back and review your choices.
errors.PHOTO_REQUIRED: A photo is required. Please take your photo again.
errors.INVALID_PHOTO: The photo could not be read. Please take it again.
errors.PHOTO_TOO_LARGE: The photo is too large. Please take it again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach the server. Nothing was recorded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Your vote could not be saved. Nothing was recorded, so please try again.

receipt.title: Your vote was recorded
receipt.intro: This is your receipt. It proves that a ballot was counted, but it does not show who you voted for.
receipt.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it by hand.
receipt.keep: Save this code now. For your privacy it is not stored against your name, so it cannot be shown again.
receipt.later: After voting closes, search for your code on the public receipts list to confirm your ballot was counted.

none.title: Receipt not available
none.body: A receipt is shown only once, right after you vote. If you have already voted, use the receipt code you saved.

file.heading: DUCSU eVote - voting receipt
file.note: Keep this code. After voting closes, search for it on the public receipts list to confirm your ballot was counted. This receipt does not show who you voted for.

receipts.title: Published receipts
receipts.intro: Every ballot has one receipt code. Search for yours to confirm your ballot was counted.
receipts.searchHint: Type part of the code, for example 7KQ4.
receipts.found: A receipt with this code is on the list.
receipts.notClosed: Receipts are published after voting closes.
receipts.loadError: The receipts could not be loaded. Please try again.
